description: This file is a C header file defining the interface for the Telco Voice Manager's SSP message bus interaction components. It includes function declarations for engaging, initializing, finalizing, checking the bus, and freeing resources related to the message bus.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_MessageBusEngage
methods.description: Engages the message bus for a specific component using provided IDs, config file, and path.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the message bus interface with user-specific data.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_Finalize
methods.description: Finalizes and cleans up the message bus interface with user-specific data.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_Buscheck
methods.description: Checks the status of the message bus.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_FreeResources
methods.description: Frees resources associated with the message bus, given the priority and user data.
